lessons.title: Entries, accounts and approvals
teaches: an entry names an account; an approval authorizes an entry

assessments.prompt: Does an entry name an account?
Does an approval authorize an entry?

lessons.title: Exceptions and reconciliation
teaches: an exception follows a missing approval; a reconciliation clears the suspense account

assessments.prompt: Does an exception follow a missing approval?
Does a reconciliation clear an account?

lessons.title: Named entry types and their approvals
teaches: which approver each named entry type requires

assessments.prompt: Does a manual entry require a controller approval?
Does an accrual entry require a controller approval?
Does a reversal entry require a preparer signature?

lessons.title: Accounts that raise the approval bar
teaches: cash and revenue entries need the treasurer; suspense entries need a reconciliation

assessments.prompt: Does a manual cash entry require a treasurer approval?
Does a suspense entry require a reconciliation?
